'''Po'xiao''' is an NPC in {{Location|Lake Heights}}.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(During the day)
:'''Po'xiao:''' Whew... Finally done. Oh, hi there.
:{{DIcon}} What are you doing?
:'''Po'xiao:''' I was just helping [[Kangjian|this gentleman]] write a eulogy.
:'''Po'xiao:''' I'm a bit of a writer, so I sometimes help the elderly or injured soldiers here by writing things for them.
:'''Po'xiao:''' There are letters, there are eulogies... There are wills...
:{{DIcon}} Wills...
:'''Po'xiao:''' The soldiers never know when their time's up. I can understand that.

;(During the night)
:'''Po'xiao:''' Well... This needs a little more polishing. We don't want his family to worry...
:'''Po'xiao:''' Ah, that might be a little too hard to understand...
:{{DIcon}} (Better not disturb him.)
----
;(Alternate dialogue)
:'''Po'xiao:''' Did you meet [[Xieyang]]?
:{{DIcon}} I did.
:'''Po'xiao:''' He... he's my brother.
:'''Po'xiao:''' Is it, like, hard to talk to him?
:'''Po'xiao:''' My brother has his own, uh, way of expressing himself.
:'''Po'xiao:''' But you could say we're similar. We both have our ways of expressing what we want to say.
:'''Po'xiao:''' In some ways, he's set an example for me.
:{{DIcon}} An example?
:'''Po'xiao:''' Yes, an example of being true to yourself, expressing yourself bravely, and not backing down even when others don't understand.
{{Dialogue End}}
